title: Proper flat morphisms with fibrewise constant functions
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a proper, flat morphism of schemes [def-weil-scheme-over-base] of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Assume that for every point $s\in S$, with residue field $\kappa(s)$, the canonical map $\kappa(s)\to H^0(X_s,\mathcal O_{X_s})$ on the fibre $X_s$ is an isomorphism. Then $f_*\mathcal O_X\cong\mathcal O_S$, and this isomorphism remains true after every base change $T\to S$ [def-pc-base-change].

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-rf-perfect-base-change] to $\mathcal G=\mathcal O_X$: $f$ is proper and of finite presentation, and $\mathcal O_X$ is an $\mathcal O_X$-module of finite presentation which is flat over $S$ because $f$ is flat. Hence $K=Rf_*\mathcal O_X$ is a perfect object of $D(\mathcal O_S)$, and for every morphism $g:T\to S$ the canonical map $Lg^*K\to Rf_{T,*}\mathcal O_{X_T}$ is an isomorphism. Let $u:\mathcal O_S\to K$ be the adjunction unit; its pullback $Lg^*u$ corresponds under this isomorphism to the unit $\mathcal O_T\to Rf_{T,*}\mathcal O_{X_T}$. Taking $g=g_s:\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)\to S$ for $s\in S$, the complex $K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_S}\kappa(s)$ is identified with $Rf_{s,*}\mathcal O_{X_s}$, i.e. with $R\Gamma(X_s,\mathcal O_{X_s})$ over the field $\kappa(s)$. This is the derived image of a single sheaf, so $H^i(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}\kappa(s))=0$ for $i<0$, and $H^0(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}\kappa(s))=H^0(X_s,\mathcal O_{X_s})$, with the map induced by $u$ being the canonical map $\kappa(s)\to H^0(X_s,\mathcal O_{X_s})$.

source.place: Tag 0E62, reduction to the perfect-complex criterion

proof.text: By hypothesis the map $\kappa(s)\to H^0(X_s,\mathcal O_{X_s})$ is an isomorphism for every $s$, so by step 1 the pair $(K,u)$ satisfies the hypotheses of [lem-sc-perfect-degree-zero-fibre-criterion], which gives $\mathcal O_S\cong H^0(K)=f_*\mathcal O_X$ via $H^0(u)$. For a base change $g:T\to S$, apply the same criterion to $(Lg^*K,Lg^*u)$ on $T$: $Lg^*K$ is perfect, and for $t\in T$ over $s\in S$ the transitivity of derived pullback along $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)\to T\to S$ gives $Lg^*K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_T}\kappa(t)\cong(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_S}\kappa(s))\otimes_{\kappa(s)}\kappa(t)$. Since $\kappa(s)\to\kappa(t)$ is a field extension, hence exact, the cohomology in degrees $<0$ still vanishes and the degree-zero map induced by $Lg^*u$ is the isomorphism of the fibre at $s$ tensored with $\kappa(t)$. The criterion gives $\mathcal O_T\cong H^0(Lg^*K)$, and $H^0(Lg^*K)\cong H^0(Rf_{T,*}\mathcal O_{X_T})=f_{T,*}\mathcal O_{X_T}$ by step 1.
